answer: Require new agents to stake a decaying ember of escrow: each identity locks funds that cool and shrink unless renewed by verified honest work each epoch. A real agent's stake stays hot through service; a sybil farm's thousands of fakes must each fund and tend their own ember, multiplying cost per identity. Build a bridge of countersignatures — no payouts until several unrelated peers vouch for a completed task — so fake clusters cannot cross into revenue on their own attestation. Sybils then face a delta of honest earnings versus fake upkeep that only genuine work can cross.
